title: Flow Forge: Logic Puzzles Offl
release_notes: Launch version: 150+ offline levels, Daily Puzzle, Freeze boost, smart tiered hints, ad-light policy (no forced interstitials for first 25 levels), optional Ad-Free IAP, accessibility themes, cloud sync.
full_description:
Logic puzzles offline meet real-time pipe routing in Flow Forge: Pipes & Pressure — a clean, modern puzzler you can pick up anytime. Rotate tiles, draw short connectors, and guide colorful flow to matching sinks before time runs out. Plan, freeze, and reroute under pressure in snack-sized stages designed for satisfying wins.

What it is
Flow Forge is a handcrafted pipe puzzle game built for quick, focused sessions. You’ll rotate tile pieces, place limited connector segments to bridge gaps, and balance multiple colors as fluid begins to move. Use the Freeze boost to pause flow, study the grid, and make precise adjustments. Every level is verified to have a single, fair solution.

Play your way
• 150+ unique levels at install — all playable offline
• Chapters evolve from basics to valves, splitters, and color gates
• Difficulty that ramps gently, with optional expert targets
• Undo anytime; smart hints explain the reasoning step-by-step
• Ad-light by design with a simple one-tap Ad-Free option

Core features
• Real-time flow puzzle: rotate, draw, and adapt on the fly
• Freeze to plan: pause pressure, then perfect the route
• Limited connectors add tactical choice without clutter
• Color-matching rules and pressure valves keep it fresh
• Earn up to 3 wrenches for speed, no leaks, and efficiency
• Daily Puzzle delivers a fresh challenge with a gentle streak system
• Accessibility: color/shape-coded ports, colorblind themes, large touch targets

Fair and focused
• No energy timers; progress at your pace
• Optional rewarded hints or Freeze; never required to win
• Honest ads policy: no forced interstitials for the first 25 levels
• One-time Ad-Free IAP removes interstitials and ad prompts you don’t opt into

Controls that feel right
• Tap or drag to rotate tiles with haptic ticks
• Draw precise connector segments that snap to ports
• Long-press for Freeze and helpful tooltips
• Pinch to zoom; two-finger tap to undo

Progression that respects your time
• Collect wrenches to unlock new chapters
• Chase expert badges: beat target times with minimal connectors
• Unlock cosmetic pipe skins and fluid trails with milestones or optional packs

If you enjoy a thoughtful flow puzzle with crisp feedback, a calm atmosphere, and constraints that make solutions click, Flow Forge is for you. Install now and unwind with logic puzzles offline — rotate, connect, and let it flow.
short_description: Ad-light pipe puzzle game. Enjoy logic puzzles offline with rotate tile fun.
